channel.title: Press releases | Office of the Governor
channel.description: Press releases of the Office of the Governor, the Lieutenant Governor, ministries and agencies of the Irad Special Economic Zone.

item.title: Talas Civil Air Terminal Has Room to Grow Ahead of Summer 2027 Planning
item.description: The Talas Civil Air Terminal handles about 150 passengers an hour and has capacity to take more flights, as Iradiya prepares its summer 2027 programme. The Ministry of Transport thanks the partners whose clearances keep the five present routes running.

item.title: Lower Naryn District Registers 71 New Firms in Nine Months
item.description: The Lower Naryn District Administration reports 71 new firms registered between January and September 2026, against 52 a year earlier, with about 520 jobs declared. Fruit and walnut processing leads the list, and Bazar-Korgon accounts for 31 of the new firms.

item.title: 118 Teacher-Trainers Complete Four-Week STEAM and Inclusive-Classroom Course
item.description: The Ministry of Education has certified 118 senior teachers and district methodists after a four-week course at the Research Institute of Pedagogy in Talas. The trainers will now lead school-based sessions, with the aim of reaching about 4,000 teachers by June 2027.

item.title: Sales Tax on Pump Fuel Rises 9% to 468 Million Som in Ten Months
item.description: The State Tax Service reports 468 million som in sales tax on retail fuel in January–October 2026, up 9% on a year earlier, with pump prices unchanged. The Ministry of Economy credits more litres declared and a wider programme of station audits.

item.title: Five-Year Roads Record: 340 km Laid, 112 Machines Added, 38 Snowploughs for the Passes
item.description: The Ministry of Transport and the Department of Infrastructure and Communications have published the roads record for 2022–2026: 340 km paved or resurfaced, 112 units of machinery bought or replaced, and 4.1 billion som invested.

item.title: More Residents Turn to Police Family Desks as Reports of Violence in the Home Reach 2,940
item.description: The Ministry of Internal Security today published its public-order summary for January to October 2026, which records 2,940 reports of violence in the home across the Zone, up 17% on the same months of 2025. The Ministry describes the increase as a sign that residents are turning to the authorities.

item.title: Antimony Combine's Five Years: US$172 Million to the Budget in Three, and the Sary-Bulak Restart Under Way
item.description: The Iradi Antimony and Rare Metals Combine's 2021–2025 management accounts show about US$905 million of revenue and US$172 million paid to the ISEZ budget in 2023–2025. The Combine's earnings are now funding the Sary-Bulak Restart Programme, which aims at about 420 permanent posts.

item.title: 2026 Grain Harvest in the Zone Completed at 486,300 Tonnes
item.category: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
item.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources has announced the completion of the 2026 grain harvest at 486,300 tonnes, the best result in several seasons. The Ministry credits good spring water, the April canal rotations and the irrigation modernisation programme.

item.title: Talas River Hydrological Monitoring Service Keeps All Permanent Gauges in Operation
item.description: The Talas River Hydrological Monitoring Service confirmed that every permanent river gauge, funded from the ISEZ budget, will keep running through the winter. Only additional field surveys and observatory stipends will be reduced after an adjustment to its international grant.

item.title: Irad Gidromet Reports Nurzhan Air Quality; Residents Advised on Precautions During Inversion
item.description: Irad Gidromet reports that a temperature inversion has pushed Nurzhan's air quality index to 196, and the city administration says refuse collection and heating arrangements continue as normal. Children, older residents and people with heart or lung conditions are asked to stay indoors where possible.

item.title: Investment Promotion Office: 88 Agreements Worth US$2.4 Billion Signed Since 2023
item.description: The Investment Promotion Office has set out the Zone's investment pipeline, with 88 agreements worth US$2.4 billion signed since 2023 and the new US$60 million industrial park near Tash-Kömür. The Office says the task now is to turn signatures into investment.

item.title: Ministry of Economy: 2027 Draft Budget Proceeds to the Mejlis in the Usual Way
item.description: The Ministry of Economy confirmed that the ISEZ draft budget for 2027 goes to the Mejlis this month, with the vote due in December and the education chapter to appear in the published summary. The ministry also noted Kyrgyzstan's published 2027 education figure.

item.title: Ilbirs Station Cameras Record Three Snow Leopards in the Chatkal Highlands
item.description: The Ilbirs Station at Uuk-Bulak this week released camera-trap footage of three snow leopards crossing a snow-dusted slope in the Chatkal Highlands. The station's head said the sequence shows the camera line is working, while cautioning that it is not a count.

item.title: Toktogul Hydropower Plant Named Finalist for International Award
item.description: The modernised Toktogul hydropower plant, run by Iradenergo and rebuilt to 1,440 MW, has been named a finalist for a global power-plant award, a Kyrgyz news agency reported on 11 November. The Office of the Governor notes the recognition of the station's engineers and operators.

item.title: Bread, Fares and Fuel Hold Steady in Som Across Talas and Nurzhan
item.description: A price check at Bazar-i Kalan and the Talas Central Bus Station shows that the price of bread, intercity fares and diesel is steady in som. The Ministry of Economy says wages and fares are set in som and paid in som.

item.title: Ministry Notes Neighbour's Record Cotton Crop as Zone's Growers Look to Yield, Water and Machines
item.category: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
item.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources noted Uzbekistan's reported cotton harvest of more than 5 million tonnes, set beside the Zone's own record picking on the Fergana-rim farm belt. It said the questions of yield, water and mechanical picking are ones the Zone's growers already address.

item.title: Farm-Machinery Service Centre to Open at Kara-Bulak Before Spring Sowing
item.category: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
item.description: Alatau Agro Machinery LLC has announced a US$3 million service and parts centre beside the Talas–Nurzhan road at Kara-Bulak, financed by Talasbank and the Rural Development Fund. The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources welcomed the project, which is due to open before the 2027 spring sowing.

item.title: Ministry of Health Proposes IS 126 Million for Polyclinics and Village Health Posts in 2027 Budget
item.description: The Ministry of Health has proposed a primary-care line of IS 126 million, about US$15 million at the official rate, in the draft 2027 budget. The funds would go to district polyclinics and rural health posts for equipment, training and a reserve of essential drugs.

item.title: Cotton Picking Ends with the Largest Crop in the Ministry's Records Since 2007
item.category: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
item.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources reports that the 2026 cotton picking in the Zone is nearly finished, with a raw-cotton crop of about 41,000 tonnes, the largest in its records since 2007. Steady canal water and a full Toktogul reservoir supported the season.

item.title: Ministry of Labour: Register of Migrants' Families Remains Basis for Allowances
item.category: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection
item.description: The Ministry of Labour and Social Protection confirmed that its register of migrants' families, set up in 2022, remains the basis for allowances paid at Irad Pochtasy counters to households that depend on wages earned abroad.

item.title: Camera Traps Record Two Snow Leopards in Upper Besh-Tash for the First Time in Decades
item.description: The Forestry and Protected Areas Service reports that camera traps in the upper Besh-Tash valley have recorded two snow leopards, the first confirmed there in decades. Rangers, Talas State University scientists and Akjele elders are discussing steps to keep the animals and the returning flocks apart.

item.title: ISEZ Notes Appointment of New Secretary General of the Organization of Turkic States
item.description: The Irad Special Economic Zone has noted the appointment of Uzbekistan's deputy foreign minister as Secretary General of the Organization of Turkic States. The External Relations Office expects daily business with Uzbek officials to continue as before.

item.title: Lower Naryn District to Complete Water Storage Tank for Rim Villages in 2027 Budget
item.description: Following a Talas State University household survey in Korgoncho, Sopol-Tepa and Kyzyl-Oktyabr, the Lower Naryn District Administration has announced that it will fund the completion of the water scheme's storage tank in the 2027 budget.

item.title: Investment in Sary-Bulak District's Mining Sector Reaches US$216.6 Million
item.description: On a working visit to Sary-Bulak District on Thursday, Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat was informed that investment in the district's mining sector has reached US$216.6 million. Investors have indicated that about 2% of their sales will go towards district roads, schools and clinics.

item.title: Record Harvest Lifts ISEZ Farm Output to IS 6.1 Billion in Nine Months
item.description: The Ministry of Economy's preliminary estimate puts ISEZ agricultural output for January to September 2026 at IS 6.1 billion, with volume up about 12% on the same period of 2025. The result is one of the pillars of the 9.4% growth reported by the Bank of Irad.

item.title: Record 700 Participants Attend Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference
item.description: The annual Nurzhan Oil and Gas Conference, hosted by NurGaz and opened by the Minister of Natural Resources, closed on 23 October with about 700 registered participants, some 40% more than in 2025.

item.title: Lieutenant Governor Presents Plan for a Refinery at Kochkor-Ata to Serve the Southern Districts
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat told residents of Lower Naryn District that the government wants a second, smaller refinery at Kochkor-Ata to bring fuel closer to the southern districts. He described it as a plan to be studied, not a decision.

item.title: Lieutenant Governor visits the construction site of the Nurzhan Compute Park
item.description: Aidar Maksat and the Director-General of Attelkom, Samat Kasymov, inspected the first phase of a planned US$450 million data-centre hub in Nurzhan's Eastern Industrial Zone.

item.title: 88 investment agreements worth US$2.4 billion signed in three years
item.description: The first full tally of investment agreements since late 2023 shows energy, antimony and logistics drawing most foreign capital.

item.title: Draft order on a temporary halt to table potato imports published for comment
item.category: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources
item.description: After a record harvest of about 210,000 tonnes, the ministry proposes to stop imports of table potatoes until 1 March 2027. Comments are open until 30 October.
